svg.title: Shared evidence functions across product forms
svg.desc: Shared evidence functions across product forms Prospective analytical model | the columns are not legal categories or maturity stages Physical products Components and materials Performance evidence Repair and lifecycle events Product configuration Physical AI Hardware and firmware Models and executable skills Task and environment Context and memory Virtual products Software and model versions Tools and dependencies Deployment settings Service evaluations Shared evidence functions Identity and configuration | provenance and semantics | authority and access | status and version history Decision-specific assurance Does this evidence apply to this configured system, purpose and operating context? Local enforcement and action Control admission, stale context and memory reuse. Handle committed physical effects separately.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Shared evidence functions across product forms

Physical products, physical AI and virtual products connect to shared evidence functions and separate decision and enforcement controls. Author-proposed evidence model spanning product forms. The columns are neither legal categories nor maturity stages. Shared semantics and provenance do not establish authority, safe operation or institutional acceptance. No cross-domain validation of this model was performed. Paper Figure 6, page 39.
